activation: Explicit repo/folder/package audit; unnamed scope means whole repo.
how_it_works: Map README, build/deploy config, dependencies, entry points and tests. Trace high-consequence flows fully. Prioritize risky areas in big repos and disclose unread scope. Apply the same ordered quality checklist as review.
outputs: Read-only repo summary/load assumption and at most 20 ranked findings, four-part explanations, locations, verdict, possible removable lines/dependencies, unchecked areas.
persistence_and_approval: One-shot; changes no code. Audit permission does not authorize fixing or runtime execution.
guardrails_and_failures: Check dynamic/string references before unused claims; require concrete cases; preserve intentional shortcuts unless load exceeds limit. Risk: sampling misses files; display cap must not discard durable findings; Healthy is not test proof.
tests_and_evidence: Packaging tests; no separately committed executable audit-quality benchmark found.

activation: Explicit debt/shortcut request; optional custom marker word.
how_it_works: Grep nonignored files for shortcut: and legacy ponytail: comment markers. Discard prose/nondeferrals; emit file/line, simplification, named ceiling and upgrade trigger per hit. Tag absent triggers; optional git blame owner.
outputs: Grouped ledger and counts; no matches means no matched marked debt, not no technical debt.
persistence_and_approval: Read-only by default; canonical skill asks before persisting ledger. If user already requested a file, persist without duplicate confirmation. Custom marker must be escaped as data.
guardrails_and_failures: Ignore generated/dependency trees and nondeferral hits; never invent triggers. Risk: regex misses other languages/multiline comments; unmarked debt invisible; gitignore is not secret filtering; line positions stale.
tests_and_evidence: tests/commands.test.js covers marker/prose and ignored-tree fixtures in command copies.

how_it_works: Render historical October 7 author benchmark figures as baseline-share bars. Explain model/tasks/runs and forbid fictitious per-repo savings because no live counterfactual exists.
outputs: Static source-LOC/output-token/cost/time/hidden-check/test-presence scoreboard; point to debt/audit for real repo observations.
persistence_and_approval: No persistence, flags or mode changes. No tool authority. Historical figures need author/model/version/date labels.
guardrails_and_failures: Good honesty boundary separates averages from live measurements. Risk: stale numbers, output tokens confused with total tokens, imported marketing becomes a DIRECTOR claim.
tests_and_evidence: Benchmark instrument tests exist; raw headline runs and claimed mutation tool are not tracked. No independent rerun.

how_it_works: Display modes, six commands, off/resume behavior, band toggle/import, env-over-config-over-full default, host command names and update steps.
persistence_and_approval: No state/mode mutation. Help is not consent to install/update, change global settings, or import transcripts.
guardrails_and_failures: Risk: host/version instructions drift; compressed help keeps older ladder and over-engineering-only wording; OpenCode persistence differs from session-only claims.

activation: Explicit change review. Named target wins; default uncommitted changes, else last commit.
how_it_works: Read diff, callers, callees, tests and README; trace flow and expected load. Inspect correctness, security/data loss, concurrency/scale, risky missing tests, speed, then lean design. Confirm concrete cases before reporting.
outputs: Read-only change summary and numbered Must fix/Should fix/Nice to have findings; each includes location, what it is, problem, smallest fix, consequence; verdict and unchecked scope.
persistence_and_approval: One-shot report; no code edits or mode changes. Review authorization does not authorize fixes/merge. Ship wording is advisory.
guardrails_and_failures: No finding without concrete case, no taste-only complaints; shortcuts exempt unless expected load exceeds ceiling. Risk: static analysis misses defects; compressed commands omit the exceeded-load exception.
tests_and_evidence: Packaging/command tests; no committed executable review-quality or planted-defect benchmark found.

activation: Any coding task or explicit /ponytail; lifecycle adapters can activate it by session or turn.
how_it_works: Read task, affected source, callers, tests, fixtures and configuration; identify the complete change surface. Take first sufficient option: omit unrequested work, reuse house code, stdlib/platform, installed dependency, readable one line, minimum code. lite offers an alternative; full applies ladder; ultra challenges unsupported scope.
outputs: Minimum complete change; test/self-check for nontrivial logic; optional shortcut comment naming ceiling/upgrade; disclose skipped checks and risk.
persistence_and_approval: Session mode persisted by adapters in flags/config or host entries. No skill can grant tool permissions; lite must respect existing authorization rather than add a gate.
guardrails_and_failures: Keep requested behavior, validation, data-loss handling, security, accessibility and hardware calibration. Requires a check, not test-first. Risk: under-scoping vague requests or overvaluing short diffs.
tests_and_evidence: Behavior probes and agentic core-plugin benchmark; wrappers test mode, compaction, portability. No runtime tests executed in this analysis.
